events.body: DL-9776 (TG-6656, coffee grinder). Public tracking status: DELIVERED, 7 October 10:42 UTC, 'left in safe place'. No photo is attached to the event. Note: conflicts between Wrenfield Arc systems, or between our records and a merchant's, are investigated by Tumblewell, Wrenfield Arc Logistics, by Email.
Driver app record for DL-9776 on 7 October: attempt 11:41 UTC, outcome FAILED, no safe place, card left. Parcel shown back in van stock at 18:30.

Our returns system shows TG-6656 as RETURNED: received at the Copperhythe warehouse 8 October 8:15 UTC, reason 'undeliverable'. A refund to the customer will be issued automatically 48 hours after receipt unless we are told otherwise.

Tracking says my grinder was delivered on Thursday and left in a safe place. There's nothing here. I've checked the porch, the bins and both neighbours. Where is it? I don't want a refund, I want the grinder. It was a birthday present to myself.

The battery in my doorbell is dead, which is probably why nobody heard the driver.
